panels.title: Relay workers
panels.description: The Optiplex long-polling for searches.

panels.title: Flash fails now
panels.description: Slots whose current stream failed its last flash check.

panels.title: Oldest waiting check
panels.description: New, candidate and manual resolution + flash jobs wait for the Optiplex worker (every 20 min); the daily batch is in Check queue.

panels.title: Start-up problems, last 3 h
panels.description: Last 3 h, per ticket request: a slow video the player retries counts several timeouts. A timeout means the player waited 90 s and got youtube.com at 360p.

panels.title: Tunelio build time
panels.description: Visitors’ progressive builds (p95 over 3 h, from the daily buckets) and the speed probe’s latest start times (src/probe.js). Over ~20 s the visitor waits past the resolver hold; over ~100 s the player gives up.

panels.title: In world (production)
panels.description: VRChat’s world counts, polled about every minute (japharsworld-yt-occupants.timer). VRChat updates them on its own schedule.

panels.title: Total visits (production)
panels.description: All-time counts from VRChat. Grafana has them from 2026-10-21; /stats has the daily history before that.

panels.title: Search latency
panels.description: From the daily buckets, over 3 h windows.

panels.title: Tunelio build time
panels.description: From the daily buckets, over 6 h windows. A player is held up to 90 s, the resolver 12 s (claude/play-latency.md).

panels.title: Start-up problems (per 3 h)
panels.description: Per ticket request, so one slow video retried by the player counts several timeouts; plays count once per room.

panels.title: Tunelio probe: time to start
panels.description: Speed probe about hourly (src/probe.js; every ~20 min before 2026-10-23): a fresh 12–30 min video at 1080p, progressive and HLS on alternate runs, so each line moves about every 2–2.5 h. Start = what a player waits for (progressive: first byte; HLS: playlist + first segment).

panels.title: Tunelio probe: build speed
panels.description: Speed probe about hourly (src/probe.js; every ~20 min before 2026-10-23): a fresh 12–30 min video at 1080p, progressive and HLS on alternate runs, so each line moves about every 2–2.5 h. Start = what a player waits for (progressive: first byte; HLS: playlist + first segment). 2026-10-19 measured ~60 MB/s progressive.

panels.title: Playback plans (per 6 h)
panels.description: Which plan each video got (src/adaptive.js): plan_direct = 1080p at once, plan_adaptive = 720p then 1080p, plan_start = the 360p first rung, plan_lower = 720p only; paced_off = kept at 720p by the credit pacer.

panels.title: Adaptive steps and Quest tickets (per 6 h)
panels.description: master = adaptive playlists served, upgrade / upgrade_served / upgrade_failed = 1080p step-ups started, played, failed; hls_ticket = .m3u8 tickets (the world’s Android build); android_progressive = Quest players sent progressive; defer = resolver told to wait. reload_after_upgrade / reload_before_upgrade = the same player loading the master again after / before it got 1080p: the freeze proxy (a freeze shows no error, so Play pressed again is the closest signal; compare the two).

panels.title: Ticket requests by client (per 6 h)
panels.description: string = the tablet’s status checks, ytdlp = VRChat’s resolver, avpro = the player. Per request, not per play.

panels.title: Home relay today
panels.description: What the Optiplex downloaded for home relay plays today (Chicago day) against HOME_DAILY_MB, what the worker uploaded from its own cache instead (not counted against the cap, relay/cache.js), and the media workers connected now. Set every minute by the search service.

panels.title: Home relay (per 6 h)
panels.description: Sessions started / ready / failed / capped (refused by the daily cap) / timeout, and why a play went home (long video, Tunelio off or failed, the pacer).

panels.title: Home relay start time
panels.description: Play → first playlist with a segment from the Optiplex, 6 h windows.

panels.title: Credits spent per day, by use
panels.description: playback = /create for visitors, captions = transcripts, probe = the speed probe, test = test slot refills. Rolling 24 h.

panels.title: Search sources (per 6 h)
panels.description: worker = the Optiplex relay, local = InnerTube from the Linode, api = the YouTube Data API (quota).

panels.title: Captions (per 6 h)
panels.description: Track lists and tracks served, which source answered (worker, local yt-dlp, Tunelio), word timing real or estimated, and why none was available.

panels.title: YouTube refusals (per hour)
panels.description: Failed YouTube lookups by where (home = the Optiplex relay, linode) and class: bot = "Sign in to confirm", rate = 429 / try again later / a caption track that failed after its list, forbidden = 403, potoken = PO token, other. Counted from 2026-10-25 (src/refusal.js).

panels.title: Rooms active (shards with a request, per hour)
panels.description: Distinct shards that saw a request in the past hour (from the hourly shard table).

panels.title: Plays by platform (per 6 h)
panels.description: Once per room and platform (a room with PC and Quest players counts one of each), from the player’s User-Agent or a .m3u8 ticket. Counted from 2026-10-23.

panels.title: Room quality picks and tablet warm-ups (per 6 h)
Failed units
panels.description: japharsworld-yt units, bgutil-pot and caddy in the failed state.

panels.title: World uploads and releases
panels.description: VRChat world versions (world:prod, world:test, at VRChat’s upload time) and GitHub release tags.

panels.title: Deploys of main
panels.description: Per host: the Linode (search service; no_restart = only files it does not run changed) and the Optiplex (relay worker). deploy/deploy-record.sh.
